note: auto_approve is ON: posts that pass every automatic check are approved by the system and go out at their slot; a tap on a card's red cross before the slot stops one. A post that fails a check is sent to Telegram marked with what failed and only goes out if you approve it. tiktok_packages: after a Reel is published it is also sent to Telegram with its caption, ready to upload to TikTok by hand. Set auto_approve false to pause. station_footage: true (James, 2026-11-22: real video in Reels) = up to 8 s of a news story's footage, credited on screen, from a public body's own channel first (Parliament, State House, Judiciary, Treasury, IEBC: tvclip_local.PUBLIC_BODIES) or else a TV station's; false = none, and a fetched clip is deleted unused.
